decisions.reason: As a renamed and improved trommel screen based on an already accepted machine, it fits the firm's core screening business and would normally stay in the portfolio.
The mobile flail shredder line is close to the firm's main mobile waste-processing applications, so a mature machinery maker would usually continue backing it after several years on the market.
Although less prominently presented, the mobile high-speed grinder still matches the firm's core processing offer and is more likely to be retained than withdrawn.
The stationary electric fine shredder is a narrower product but it supports the firm's resource-saving and efficient-processing direction, making continued marketing the likelier choice.
A multi-model stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line with a dedicated page fits the established shredding portfolio and would usually be kept as part of a full-range offer.
